lines.en: I fly right at your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的帽檐飘了一圈。
lines.en: I drift a full circle along your hat brim.
I sway slowly in the air.
I count the little lights in the fog.

lines.zh: 我绕着主人转圈，等你下令。
lines.en: I circle my master, waiting for orders.

lines.zh: 我数着你还剩多少体力。
lines.en: I count what stamina you have left.
I copy the way you walk.

lines.zh: 我在你的背包边蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I nudge up against your pack.

lines.zh: 我缩成光点，飘在你肩后。
lines.en: I shrink to a glimmer floating behind your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的身影在雾里，我很熟。
lines.en: Your shape in the fog is familiar to me.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我就跟着偏一点。
lines.en: When you raise your hand, I tilt with it.

lines.zh: 你踩过的草，还留着方向。
lines.en: The grass you stepped on still shows which way.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的背包带，怕你走。
lines.en: I watch your pack strap, afraid you'll leave.
I hover behind your shoulder without a sound.

lines.zh: 你每动一下，我的光就跳一下。
lines.en: Every time you move, my light flickers.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，怕你丢下我。
lines.en: I watch your hands, afraid you'll leave me.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的目光就到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my gaze follows.

lines.zh: 你的睫毛上沾着灰，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the ash on your eyelashes.
I drift from your left side to your right.

lines.zh: 你回头时我已经在看你了。
lines.en: You turn, and I'm already watching.

lines.zh: 我怕你忘了我还在这儿。
lines.en: I fear you'll forget I'm still here.

lines.zh: 我在你帽檐上往下看你。
lines.en: I look down at you from your hat brim.

lines.zh: 主人在哪，我的体力快空了。
lines.en: Where's my master? My stamina is nearly gone.

lines.zh: 我只剩八点生命，浮不稳了。
lines.en: Only eight hearts left; I can't stay afloat.

lines.zh: 我的光暗了一下，快接住我。
lines.en: My light dimmed; catch me quickly.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里，有我喜欢的味。
lines.en: There's a smell I like in your pocket.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扫到你的耳后。
lines.en: My wing brushed behind your ear.

lines.zh: 我的叶子蹭到你的耳朵。
lines.en: My leaves brush against your ear.

lines.zh: 我撞在门框上，晕了一下。
lines.en: I hit the door frame and daze myself.
The sprout on me has been knocked askew.

lines.zh: 我的体力条还够飞一圈。
lines.en: My stamina bar can still manage a lap.
My stamina bar is nearly empty.

lines.zh: 体力条空了，我只想找伴。
lines.en: My stamina is gone; I only want a mate.

lines.zh: 我绕着你飞，翅膀都抖了。
lines.en: I circle you, my wings trembling.

lines.zh: 我的体力还够飞一小圈。
lines.en: My stamina still allows one small lap.
You hold out your hand, and I drop into the palm.
Follow me into the liminal realm!

lines.zh: 主人一吹哨，我就飞回来。
lines.en: One whistle from my master and I fly back.
I took a look for you first.

lines.zh: 我把光点推到那东西身上。
lines.en: I push my mote of light onto that thing.
My aim line cuts through this doorway.

lines.zh: 我把注意力全放在它身上。
lines.en: I put all my attention on it.

lines.zh: 那东西的影子，我替你标出来。
lines.en: I've marked that thing's shadow for you.
I'll keep watch for you, don't worry.
I gather light onto that thing.
If it moves, I'll call you.
I hang a little way ahead of you.
I'm counting how far it is from you.
Say the word, and I move.

lines.zh: 我的嫩芽竖起，像一排小刺。
lines.en: My sprouts stand up like a row of small thorns.
Feel the wrath of Decaworker Sprout!
I am a guardian, not an enemy!

lines.zh: 召我出来的那个人，还在上面。
lines.en: The one who called me is still up there.

lines.zh: 体力条见底，我也跟着沉。
lines.en: My stamina empties and I sink with it.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边的土里冒出来。
lines.en: I come up out of the soil by your feet.
Your world is about to change!
I am the messenger of fate!

lines.zh: 种子壳裂开，我飞到你面前。
lines.en: The seed husk splits and I fly before you.
The seed splits, and I fly out.
You woke me from the soil.
I make my first circle around you.
I land on your open palm.
The leaves on me are still damp.
I dropped and hit the steps.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的叶子吹散了几片。
lines.en: The blast scatters a few of my leaves.
Master, my stamina is running out.
The shock spun me in circles.

lines.zh: 这里的空处把我往下拉。
lines.en: The emptiness here pulls me down.
